notes.title: How to Say Goodbye is getting a free content update!
notes.notes:
How to Say Goodbye is getting its first free update today!

Experience Sendak's story with new levels adapted from the demo.
After they wake up in an unknown place, you must assist them as they come to term with their own passing.

👻Help Sendak reunite with their brother and navigate this strange land populated by friendly ghosts and menacing spleens. Witness their final goodbyes in this emotional prequel of the game.

notes.title: 1.0.6 update: better saving and reloading!
notes.notes:
Hi!

With this update, you will be able to pick the game back up from the last puzzle you were on, so it will be less punishing to not finish the chapter immediately :)

We're working on various accessibility features for the next update as well, to make the game more pleasant for you to play.

Thank you for spending some time with Tove and her friends! ❤

notes.title: Various bugfixes across the game
notes.notes:
Hi!
This update fixes various soft-locks found throughout the game.
If you encountered one of those, we're really sorry and hope you enjoy the game nonetheless!

The next update will allow players to resume playing from the puzzle they are currently on, without having to restart the entire chapter. There will also be a button to reload the current level, so that if you encounter a situation where you are stuck, it will be less painful to have to restart.

After that update, we will work on some accessibility features such as text scaling and colour palette tweaking, as well as a toggle, to avoid having to hold down the Interact button to move the tiles.

Thank you for playing our game! ❤

Florian & Baptiste
